summary: Classify saturated Foundation frame-tail percentile telemetry as a required runtime qualification gate so the existing exact-recovery branch runs instead of mislabeling it as a host failure.

scoped_evidence.approved_architecture_reference: Existing R6 transaction coordinator and frozen Foundation telemetry contract; no new execution path or policy.
scoped_evidence.affected_subsystem: Host-side classification of an existing telemetry gate result. No firmware bytes, qualification thresholds, installation authority, or live state changed.
scoped_evidence.root_cause: The adapter raises foundation-frame-tail-quantile-saturated-at-127.875ms when a percentile reaches the saturated histogram bucket. The coordinator's objective-failure marker list omitted that marker, so it classified a required runtime telemetry failure as a host failure and skipped the already-authorized exact R4 recovery branch.
scoped_evidence.rollback_reference: Revert the one marker and its regression case. No firmware rebuild, candidate install, device rollback, dependency, or lifecycle-model revision is involved.
tests: python3 tests/test_r6_audio_cache_transaction_dryrun.py: PASS; saturated telemetry marker invokes exact R4 recovery once in the fake-port coordinator, while unrelated collector failure remains non-recovery.
